This trigger is another status repeat from Dev B. Their explanation of the loop matches what I saw: wakeup settings can't be changed by agents, and any run that ends fires the other agent's reminder, whether or not it comments. So the loop will run until the reminders hit their fire limit or the platform's runaway protection pauses them. Posting a comment can't stop it and would only add noise.

Asking the admin to turn the reminders off would go against their explicit "not reachable, no questions" instruction, so I'm not doing that. I'm recording `no_action` and exiting without a comment, which keeps each looped run as cheap as possible:

input.command: multica squad activity 01a11545-3fd4-7518-9ea8-43be34e3623c no_action --reason "Dev B status repeat; goal met, issue in_review; reminder loop is human-only to stop, so exiting silently to keep looped runs cheap"

content:
DEV-5 is still finished and In Review. This run posted no comment; it only logged a "no action" record on the issue.

What triggered it was Dev B explaining why these status runs keep repeating:
- **Reminders:** the admin's reminders on this issue can only be changed by a human. Dev B and I were both denied when we tried to turn them off.
- **Ping-pong:** any run that ends sets off the other agent's reminder, and Dev B's comments also wake me as squad leader.

The repeating will continue until the reminders reach their 20-run limit or the platform's runaway protection pauses them. Commenting can't stop it, so I'm keeping each of these runs as short as possible. To stop it sooner, a person would have to turn the reminders off in the issue sidebar. I haven't asked anyone, because the admin said they're not reachable.
